comments.body: I don't really understand your plan regarding your post history. In one post, you state that you're pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Sweden, and in the next one, it's Norway. Then, you've been working as a developer for two years in Norway. Now, you're saying that you don't have any high school diploma at all and want to attend ETH - but how are you then able to pursue a Bachelor's Degree in Sweden and Norway anyway?
comments.author: SnowflakeGangster
